title: Premium Request
description: Request payload sent to the pricing-policy service to compute a personalised premium for a vehicle / policy.

request_id.description: Idempotency key for this premium calculation request.

vehicle_id.description: Identifier of the vehicle to price.

policy_id.description: Identifier of the existing or prospective policy.

score.description: The latest risk score for this vehicle.

coverage_type.description: Requested coverage tier (optional — defaults to current policy coverage).

requested_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the quote was requested.
